deviations: ligature across a color boundary: shaped once, so the ligature stays one glyph; it is painted once per touching color span and clipped at the selection-rectangle x (observed: Calibri 'office' shapes to 4 glyphs and each side shows its run color); a backend reporting the ligature as an atomic cluster would give it one color

decoration offsets are derived: underline at baseline + descent*0.618 and strikethrough at baseline - ascent*0.5 (the pin's own absent-offset fallbacks, line.rs:437,448); the pin reads Parley run offsets that do not cross the rev-11 ABI
ShapedLine x/index geometry uses one caret stop per logical cluster (WrappedLine.Clusters + Caret) instead of the legacy per-glyph byte index table; inside a ligature there are per-grapheme stops

ShapeLine rejects a non-nil force width (ErrTextValue): legacy apply_force_width_to_layout repositions glyphs, which the native paint path cannot; one Base call site passes a force width (input/base/element.rs line-number measurement)
LayoutWidth and LineWrapper take a FontDescriptor (the seam resolves descriptors) instead of a resolved FontId; WrapLine returns a slice instead of a lazy iterator
a real-window ShapedLine shares the window line-layout cache entry: valid for its frame and the next (no Arc refcount over native handles)
StyledText inside a Block/Inline paragraph: the paragraph painter (inline.go, not this ticket's file) paints the text in one ambient color
the line-layout cache key ignores the run paint fields (they never change shaped geometry)
CombineHighlights folds active highlights in input order (the pin folds a HashSet with unspecified order)
decision_02_note: Decision 02 expected a ligature across a color boundary to take one color; the implementation clips each run's paint to its selection rects and Parley splits a ligature's advance across its characters, so each side shows its own run color. Recorded as a deviation (visual-only, arguably closer to per-character intent); no user action needed.
